description: Scenario: server restarts after ingesting a large number of articles. store/backfill.rs::backfill_overview calls overview_store.query_range for each article individually, then fetches each article's wire bytes from IPFS one at a time. On a server with 100k articles this means 100k sequential DB queries and 100k sequential IPFS block fetches at startup, blocking readiness for minutes. The article_numbers store already has a list_all_articles method that loads all rows in one query.
title: backfill_overview makes O(n) DB round-trips and O(n) IPFS fetches at startup
